## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior, including a before/after example when useful.

## Identity and prerequisites

Phase: F___; milestone: P__; requirements: ___. Target: `main`.
Identify prerequisite merged phases and resolved blocking decisions. One phase, one primary PR.

## Included and excluded scope

State the bounded result, excluded capabilities and any explicitly disabled slices.

## Documentation and source authority

Link the feature guide, QA report, owning specifications, decisions and migration/runbook changes.
Use `docs/features/F###.md` and `docs/qa/F###.md` for the delivered phase.

## Verification

Identify measured head/base, content snapshot, exact commands/scenarios, results and safe artifacts.
Distinguish passed, failed, not run, unavailable, stale and individually justified not applicable.

## Agent QA

Record actual observations and open findings. Document inspection does not prove native/product
behavior. All applicable required evidence must be current before final owner review.

## Impacts and applicability

Explain data/schema, API/IPC, permissions/privacy, finance, offline/retry/recovery,
English/Arabic/RTL/accessibility, artifacts and native impacts separately.

## Recovery and compatibility

Describe repair, migration/backout or forward recovery and preservation of prior evidence.
Material changes invalidate affected verification and final owner approval.

## Limits and rollout

List unresolved limitations and market/provider constraints. Merge is separate from release.

## Owner decision

Pending until the user explicitly approves this concrete PR/head/base/evidence after checks and QA.
Record the trusted decision source; an approval checkbox, green checks or agent advice is not approval.
Keep owner authorization separate from independent platform review. Do not create an approval
transcription commit that changes the reviewed head. Honor existing remote requirements.

See [delivery governance](../docs/development/delivery-governance.md).
